About Our Clinic

Excellence in Dental Care

At B.Y. Speciality Dental Clinic, we believe that exceptional dental care is not a luxury — it is a right. Founded with an unwavering commitment to excellence, we have become Addis Ababa's most trusted destination for comprehensive dental services.

Our clinic stands at the intersection of world-class technology and compassionate patient care. Every treatment plan is crafted with precision, every procedure performed with artistry, and every patient experience designed to exceed expectations.

We invest continuously in the latest dental innovations, ensuring our patients receive treatments that meet and surpass international standards. Our team of specialists brings decades of combined expertise, transforming smiles and changing lives every single day.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions? We've got answers. Contact us if you need further clarification.

Are dental procedures at your clinic painful?
+
Not at all. We utilize modern anesthetics and minimally invasive techniques to ensure every treatment is entirely comfortable and virtually pain-free.
How long do dental implants last?
+
With proper care and routine hygiene visits, high-quality dental implants can last a lifetime, functioning just like natural teeth.
How often should I get my teeth cleaned professionally?
+
We recommend a professional dental checkup and scaling every 6 months to maintain optimal oral health and prevent gum disease.
Do you offer emergency dental services?
+
Yes! We accommodate urgent dental situations such as severe toothaches, chipped teeth, or lost crowns as quickly as possible.
